Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The OEM, or its authorized dealer/reseller holding a bid-specific OEM Authorization (MAF) quoting t his Bid No. and date, may participate. 2. Experience Criteria – Sanitary Napkins Only. The bidder or its OEM must have a minimum of 3 years' experience exclusively in manufacturing and supplying Sanitar y Napkins to Central/State Government Departments, Government Hospitals, Govern ment Institutions or PSUs. 3. Past supply. The bidder or its OEM (directly or through a reseller) must have supplied sanitary na pkins to any Central/State Government department, PSU or autonomous body. Cumulative quantit y supplied in any one of FY 2023-24, 2024-25 or 2025-26 must be at least 80% of the bid quantity. Copies of supply orders with matching invoices& CRAC must be uploaded with the bid. 4. Financial statements. Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account with audit report (bearin g UDIN) and ITR acknowledgements of the bidder for FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. 5. Turnover. Chartered Accountant’s certificate (with UDIN) of the bidder’s turnover for the same thr

ee years. The OEM’s turnover certificate (CA, with UDIN) for the offered product category for the sa me years. 6. OEM net worth. CA certificate (with UDIN) showing positive net worth of the Bidder’s & OEM’s as on 31.03.2026. 7. Solvency. Solvency certificate of the bidder from a Scheduled Commercial Bank for not less than t he estimated bid value, issued within the last [12] months. Or Solvency Issued by District Magistrat e Also Considered 8. Character Certificate. Character Certificate of the authorized signatory (proprietor / managing partner / director) issued by the District Magistrate of the district where the bidder firm is registered or where that p erson ordinarily resides (any district in India), issued before the bid opening date, shall be uploaded. 9. Statutory documents. PAN card and Aadhaar of the authorized signatory, GST registration certifi cate, GSTR-9 and Form 26AS for the three financial years above. 10. Quality certificates of the OEM. a. Valid BIS license (CM/L) under IS 5405 (latest revision) covering the offered product. b. ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 6887-1-2017, ISO 17088:2021, ISO 14001:2015 & ISO 10993 certificate of the OEM (and of the bidder, if the bidder is the manufacturer). c. Trademark registration certificate, or proof of application, for the offered brand. d. EPR registration under the Plastic Waste Management Rules, where applicable to the OEM/ brand owner. 11. MSE and Startup relaxation. Micro and Small Enterprises (valid Udyam) and DPIIT-recognized st artups get EMD exemption and the experience/turnover relaxations as selected in the Gem bid, un der the State Public Procurement Policy for MSEs and Gem GTC. 12. Self-attestation. Every uploaded document must be self-attested by the authorized signatory. Bi dders should upload only the documents asked for, each once. Where a document is unclear or mi ssing, the department may seek clarification through Gem within the time allowed by Gem GTC. 13. EMD. 1% of the estimated bid value, i.e. Rs. 51285.00 (Rupees ONE THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED EI GHT FIVE only), in favour of Chief Medical Officer, SAMBHAL, by any mode permitted in this Gem bid (FDR / Bank Guarantee / online). A scanned copy must be uploaded with the bid. The original in strument must reach the office of CMO SAMBHAL before technical bid opening, or within the time a llowed by Gem GTC. Eligible MSEs and startups are exempt (clause 9). 14. Refund of EMD. EMD of unsuccessful bidders will be returned after finalization of the bid. EMD of the successful bidder will be returned on receipt of the Performance Security, or adjusted towards it at the bidder’s written request. 15. Performance Security. The successful bidder shall furnish Performance Security (EPBG) of [5]% of the contract value through Gem, valid for [60] days beyond the last date of supply/warranty obli gations. It may be forfeited for breach of contract or supply of sub-standard goods, after a written show-cause notice and an opportunity to be heard. 16. Affidavit. A notarized affidavit on Rs. 100 non-judicial stamp paper, quoting this Bid No. and date, shall be uploaded with the bid and the original submitted at the office of CMO SAMBHAL five day bi d after closing date. It shall declare that: a. the bidder/firm is not blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State Government departmen t or PSU on the bid date, and was not so in the last three financial years; b. the bidder is not under liquidation, insolvency, court receivership or similar proceedings; c. the proprietor/partners/directors have not been convicted of any offence relating to public procurement; d. the bid is not collusive and prices are independently arrived at; e. all documents uploaded are genuine and true copies. 17. OEM Affidavit – Authenticity of Documents. The OEM shall submit a duly notari zed affidavit on appropriate non-judicial stamp paper, signed by its authorized signa tory, specifically mentioning the Gem Bid Number and Date, declaring that all OEM-r elated documents, including BIS/ISO certificates, manufacturing licences, laboratory test reports, biodegradability/compossibility reports and other submitted records, ar e true, genuine, authentic and valid, issued by the OEM or respective competent iss uing authorities, and have not been forged, fabricated, altered or manipulated.The a ffidavit must be uploaded along with the Technical Bid. And its Original Signed & Not arized Copy Must be Submitted at the Office of The Chief Medical Office SAMBHAL be fore The Bid Opening Date. 18. Advance samples and lab report. Two packets (six pads each) of the offered product, labelled with Bid No. and bidder name, shall be delivered at the office of CMO SAMBHAL five day bid after c losing date. A test report from a NABL-accredited / Central Government / ILAC-signatory laboratory , not older than six months on the bid opening date, covering every parameter in Part C, shall be u ploaded with the bid. Samples of unsuccessful bidders may be collected back within 30 days of aw

ard. 19. The goods shall conform to the specification attached to this bid and to the parameters below. The test report under clause 15 must cover each one. Parameter Requirement Standard IS 5405 (latest revision), with BIS Standard Mark and CM/L number Size Regular / Large, as stated in the bid quantity schedule Pad thickness Not less than15 mm, measured as per IS 5405 / declared method Absorbency Not less than 30 ml, tested as per IS 5405 Wings Side wings required Pouch Each pad individually wrapped in a disposable pouch Biodegradabilit Biodegradable and compostable, proved by test report under IS/ISO y 17088:2021 or equivalent Skin safety Skin irritation and sensitization test report under ISO 10993 series pH and microbi Within limits of IS 5405 al load Packing Six pads per packet Shelf life At least 3 years from manufacture; at least 2 years remaining on the date of supply 20. Each packet shall be printed with: a. “UP Government Supply – Not for Sale”; b. generic name of the product, brand name, and name and address of the manufacturer; c. BIS Standard Mark with CM/L number; d. toll-free consumer helpline number; e. method of use, with indication of the absorbent side; f. disposal instructions; g. batch/lot number, month and year of manufacture, and month and year of expiry; h. instructions for storage and handling. 21. Price. The quoted price shall include all costs, taxes, packing, transportation and unloading up to each consignee named in the Gem contract. Nothing extra will be paid. 22. Delivery. Supply shall be completed within 30 days of the date of the Gem contract. Delay, extens ion and liquidated damages shall be governed by Gem GTC. 23. Quantity variation. The department may increase or decrease the contracted quantity within the limits allowed by Gem GTC, at the same rate and terms. 24. Inspection and testing. The department may draw random samples from any supplied batch an d get them tested at a NABL-accredited laboratory. If a sample fails, the whole batch shall be repla ced by the supplier within [15] days at its cost, and the testing cost shall be borne by the supplier. 25. Rejected goods. Goods not matching the specification may be rejected and shall be lifted by the supplier at its own cost. 26. False documents. If any document is found false or forged, the bid/contract may be rejected or t erminated, EMD/Performance Security forfeited, and action taken under Gem’s incident managem ent policy and the law, after a show-cause notice and opportunity of hearing. 27. Payment. Payment shall be made through Gem within the time stated in Gem GTC after the recei pt and acceptance certificate (CRAC) is issued. 28. Jurisdiction. Subject to the dispute resolution clause of Gem GTC, courts at SAMBHAL shall have j urisdiction. 29. Order of precedence. This ATC shall be read with Gem GTC and the bid document. In case of conflict, Gem GTC shall prevail. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
